mapper.select: SELECT ic.code, ic.name, ic.unit, curr.value AS value, prev.value AS prev_value, curr.observation_date AS observation_date FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation curr ON ic.id = curr.indicator_id AND curr.observation_date = ( SELECT MAX(o1.observation_date) FROM indicator_observation o1 WHERE o1.indicator_id = ic.id ) LEFT JOIN indicator_observation prev ON ic.id = prev.indicator_id AND prev.observation_date = ( SELECT MAX(o2.observation_date) FROM indicator_observation o2 WHERE o2.indicator_id = ic.id AND o2.observation_date < curr.observation_date ) WHERE ic.code IN ('FED_NET_LIQ', 'M2_YOY', 'FORWARD_EPS', 'FORWARD_PER', 'CNN_FG', 'US10Y') ORDER BY ic.id

SELECT mp.trade_date, mp.close AS ndx_close, liq.value AS fed_net_liq, per.value AS forward_per FROM market_price mp LEFT JOIN indicator_observation liq ON liq.indicator_id = (SELECT id FROM indicator_catalog WHERE code = 'FED_NET_LIQ') AND liq.observation_date = mp.trade_date LEFT JOIN indicator_observation per ON per.indicator_id = (SELECT id FROM indicator_catalog WHERE code = 'FORWARD_PER') AND per.observation_date = mp.trade_date WHERE mp.symbol = :symbol ORDER BY mp.trade_date

SELECT ss.asof_date, ss.score, ss.recommendation, ss.features_json, ss.data_quality, sd.name AS strategy_name FROM signal_snapshot ss JOIN strategy_definition sd ON ss.strategy_id = sd.id WHERE sd.enabled = 1 ORDER BY ss.asof_date DESC LIMIT 1
